description: This file defines the EmployeeAttendanceSummaryListModel class, which models a list of employee attendance summaries, converting internal record data into an array format suitable for API responses within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeAttendanceSummaryListModel
classes.description: A model representing a list of employee attendance summaries, capable of converting its records into an array format for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an array of employee attendance records.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the attendance summary records into an array suitable for API output, calculating hours, minutes, and formatting the total hours.
